sonnet.problem: The question adds a claim the text never makes: that Moses 'now knows exactly who is speaking.' Verse 6 only says he hid his face because he was afraid to look at God. The statement should test one claim, and the added claim gives Moses a mental state the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

sonnet.problem: Choice card 14 has just asked what the people will take (silver and gold jewelry and clothing). Story card 15 then restates that same answer, so an answer already shown on a card is used again on a later card.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
